item.title: 'Moon-Jo-Socks-Off' vs. 'Han-River-Bird-Drop-Wish'… Why Is the Democratic Party's Base So Angry? (‘문조털래유’ 대 ‘한강새똥돼주길’… 민주당 지지층은 왜 화가 났나)
item.description:
'Moon-Jo-Socks-Off' vs. 'Han-River-Bird-Drop-Wish'… Why Is the Democratic Party's Base So Angry? (‘문조털래유’ 대 ‘한강새똥돼주길’… 민주당 지지층은 왜 화가 났나)

The internal atmosphere of the Democratic Party of Korea is growing tense. The party-government relationship, which seemed solid until recently, is rapidly fracturing over the issue of election accountability. The clashes between major factions ahead of the August party convention are escalating into an emotional and destructive dynamic, reminiscent of the extreme factional struggles of past political history. (더불어민주당의 내부 기류가 심상치 않다. 불과 얼마 전까지 공고해 보였던 당정 관계는 선거 책임론을 분수령으로 삼아 급격한 균열을 보이고 있다. 오는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 벌어지는 주류 계파 간의 충돌은 과거 정치사 속의 극단적 노선 투쟁을 연상케 할 만큼 감정적이고 파괴적인 양상으로 치닫는 중이다.)

The emergence of bizarre derogatory terms like 'Moon-Jo-Socks-Off' and 'Han-River-Bird-Drop-Wish', currently sweeping online communities and the political sphere, symbolically reveals how deeply divided the support base and internal power structure have become. 'Moon-Jo-Socks-Off', coined by pro-Lee Jae-myung supporters to disparage figures from the pro-Moon Jae-in and pro-Chung Cheong-rae factions, refers to Moon Jae-in, Cho Kuk, Kim Eo-jun, Chung Cheong-rae, and Yoo Si-min. In response, 'Han-River-Bird-Drop-Wish' targets figures from the 'new-pro-Lee Jae-myung' faction, including Han Jun-ho, Kang Deuk-gu, Kim Min-seok, Lee Dong-hyung, Kim Yong-min, Lee Eon-ju, and Song Young-gil. This study aims to deeply analyze the essence of this internal civil war and the dynamics of key players through related keyword indicators. (현재 온라인 커뮤니티와 정치권 전반을 강타한 ‘문조털래유’와 ‘한강새똥돼주길’이라는 기괴한 멸칭의 등장은 지지층과 내부 권력 구도가 얼마나 극단적으로 분열되어 있는지를 상징적으로 보여준다. 친명계 지지층이 친문 및 친청계 인사를 비하하기 위해 만든 ‘문조털래유’는 문재인, 조국, 김어준, 정청래, 유시민을 지칭하며, 이에 맞서 뉴이재명계 인사들을 공격하기 위해 고안된 ‘한강새똥돼주길’은 한준호, 강득구, 김민석, 이동형, 김용민, 이언주, 송영길을 뜻한다. 이 깊은 내전의 본질과 핵심 인물들의 역학 관계를 연관어 지표를 통해 심층적으로 분석하고자 한다.)

Currently, the ruling party's power landscape is sharply divided into two axes: one responsible for state affairs and another waging political strife over party leadership. Using the big data analysis tool SomeTrend, an analysis of objective keyword flows centered around two figures, 'Prime Minister Kim Min-seok' and 'Representative Chung Cheong-rae' (June 8-18), shown in , reveals that common symbolic elements like President Lee Jae-myung, the Democratic Party, and 'representative' form a central axis. However, beyond this axis, the detailed related keywords of both sides construct entirely separate worlds. (현재 여당 내부의 권력 지형은 국정 운영을 책임지는 축과 당권을 둘러싸고 정쟁을 벌이는 축으로 판이하게 쪼개져 있다. 빅데이터 심층 분석 도구인 썸트렌드(SomeTrend)를 통해 지난 6월 8~18일 ‘김민석 총리’와 ‘정청래 대표’ 두 인물을 중심으로 형성된 객관적 단어들의 흐름<그림 1·2>을 살펴보면, 이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당, 대표라는 상징적 공통분모가 중심축을 이루고 있음을 알 수 있다. 그러나 이 중심축을 벗어난 양측의 세부 연관어는 완전히 다른 세계를 구축하고 있다.)

First, around one axis's figure, keywords such as Sejong, growth, Ministry of SMEs and Startups, Government Seoul Complex, ministries, ministerial meeting, briefing, nomination, and personnel hearing are densely clustered. This shows a focus strictly on cabinet affairs, economic policy implementation, and the administrative and productive realm of overseeing government ministries. The keywords directly reflect a figure dedicated to achieving state outcomes as a hands-on commander linking the Blue House and the cabinet. (우선 한 축을 담당하는 인물의 주변에는 세종, 성장, 중소벤처기업부, 정부서울청사, 부처, 장관회의, 간담회, 지명, 인사청문회와 같은 단어들이 빽빽하게 포진해 있다. 이는 철저하게 내각의 실무, 경제 정책 추진, 그리고 정부 부처 통할과 관련된 행정적·생산적 영역에 치중되어 있음을 보여준다. 청와대와 내각을 잇는 실무형 사령탑으로서 국정 성과 창출에 매진하고 있는 모습이 단어 그대로 투영된 결과다.)

In contrast, keywords surrounding Representative Chung Cheong-rae, at the center of party leadership, sharply oppose terms like election defeat, report card, representative position, future, private, Daejeon, newspaper, Reform Party, and Im Mi-ae. This fully reflects the post-election wave of accountability debates within the party, controversy over the representative's position, and the internal power struggle over future leadership. (반면 당권의 중심에 선 정청래 대표 관련 키워드는 선거 패배, 성적표, 대표직, 미래, 비공개, 대전, 신문, 개혁신당, 임미애라는 단어들이 날카롭게 대립하고 있다. 이는 선거 이후 당내에 휘몰아친 책임론과 대표직 거취 논란, 그리고 미래 권력을 둘러싼 정당 내부의 정쟁 구조를 고스란히 반영한다.)

This stark contrast clearly explains why President Lee Jae-myung has recently taken steps—such as excluding or keeping distance from specific individuals at press conferences or on departure at the airport—that suggest a calculated move. From the president's perspective, it was necessary to distance himself from the party leadership mired in the mud of election defeat accountability and leadership controversy. This represents the activation of a calculated 'responsible politics' framework, aimed at preventing the party's 'election report card' fight from weakening state momentum while bolstering the cabinet-centered practical axis that can ensure policy outcomes and growth. (이러한 극명한 대비는 이재명 대통령이 최근 보여준 행보, 즉 기자회견이나 공항 출국길 등에서 특정 인물을 배제하거나 거리를 두는 듯한 태도를 취한 이유를 명확하게 설명해 준다. 대통령의 입장에서는 선거 패배의 책임론과 대표직 논란이라는 진흙탕 속에 빠진 당 지도부와 거리를 둘 필요가 있었을 것이다. 당의 ‘선거 성적표’ 싸움에 휘말려 국정 동력이 약화되는 것을 차단하는 동시에, 정책 성과와 성장을 담보할 수 있는 내각 중심의 실무 축에 힘을 실어주려는 계산된 ‘책임 정치’ 프레임의 가동인 셈이다.)

This objective division in the power landscape manifests as even more explosive conflict in the psychological and emotional realms felt by supporters and the parties involved. The most massive and overwhelmingly derived emotional keywords for both figures are none other than conflict, controversy, criticism, concern, objection, and election fraud. (이러한 객관적 지형 분리는 지지층과 당사자들이 느끼는 심리적·감성적 영역에서 더욱 폭발적인 갈등으로 표출된다. 두 인물 모두에게서 가장 거대하고 압도적으로 도출되는 감성어는 다름 아닌 갈등, 논란, 비판, 우려, 이의신청, 부정선거이다.)

This shows that the frontlines ahead of the August party convention have reached an emotional tipping point where it's not a simple policy competition but a fight for survival—eliminate the opponent or be eliminated. Looking at the emotional keyword flow of the axis leading the cabinet (Kim Min-seok), despite heavy words like criticism, concern, and suspicion, positive indicators such as support, success, presence, trust, and inclusion strongly persist. This suggests the existence of political assets to overcome conflict and secure public trust in state management through administrative achievements. (이는 현재 8월 전당대회를 앞둔 전선이 단순한 정책 경쟁이 아니라, 상대방을 전멸시켜야 내가 사는 감정적 임계점에 도달했음을 보여준다. 내각을 이끄는 축(김민석)의 감성어 흐름을 보면, 비판과 우려, 의혹이라는 무거운 단어들 속에서도 힘 싣다, 성공, 존재감, 신뢰, 포용이라는 긍정적 지표들이 강하게 버티고 있다. 이는 행정적 성과를 통해 갈등을 돌파하고 국정운영의 신뢰를 확보할 수 있는 정치적 자산이 존재함을 시사한다.)

However, the emotional keyword flow for Chung Cheong-rae's side is far more fatalistic and defensive. Words like controversy, conflict, and defeat dominate the forefront, while harsh language like criticize, backlash, and discontent prevails. Although some buffer zone words like agree, empathize, and inclusion exist, the energy of 'backlash' and 'discontent' from internal critics targeting the party leadership after the election defeat is overwhelmingly high. Ultimately, as these emotional related keywords prove, the emotional gap between the traditional 'rightful member' base represented by 'Moon-Jo-Socks-Off' and the new mainstream pro-Lee faction symbolized by 'Han-River-Bird-Drop-Wish' is filled with 'discontent' and 'criticism' toward each other. This state is akin to a powder keg, ready to explode catastrophically in the party convention primary process with just the slightest spark. (그러나 정청래 측의 감성어 흐름은 훨씬 치명적이고 방어적이다. 논란과 갈등, 패배라는 단어가 전면에 등장한 가운데 비판하다, 반발, 불만이라는 거친 언어들이 주를 이루고 있다. 동의하다, 공감하다, 포용 같은 완충 지대의 단어들이 일부 존재하긴 하지만, 선거 패배 이후 당 지도부를 향해 쏟아지는 당내 비판 세력의 ‘반발’과 ‘불만’의 에너지가 압도적으로 높다. 결국 ‘문조털래유’로 대변되는 전통적 권리당원 세력과 ‘한강새똥돼주길’로 상징되는 신주류 친명 세력 간의 감정적 골은 이 감성 연관어들이 증명하듯 서로를 향한 ‘불만’과 ‘비판’으로 가득 차 있으며, 이는 전당대회 경선 과정에서 아주 작은 불씨만 튀어도 언제든 파국적 형태로 폭발할 수 있는 화약고와 같다.)

The August party convention to elect the next party leader is not just about seizing party power; it is an absolute gateway to controlling nominations for future general elections. Therefore, both factions will engage in an uncompromising zero-sum game, and the political landscape is expected to violently shift in three possible directions. (차기 당 대표를 선출하는 8월 전당대회는 단순한 당권 장악을 넘어, 향후 총선의 공천권을 쥐는 절대적인 길목이다. 따라서 양 계파는 타협 없는 제로섬 게임을 벌이게 될 것이며, 향후 정국은 세 가지 방향으로 격렬하게 요동칠 것으로 전망된다.)

The battle of derogatory terms like 'Moon-Jo-Socks-Off' and 'Han-River-Bird-Drop-Wish' is a tragic portrait of the current state of South Korean politics. The mockery and hateful language supporters hurl at each other have devolved into tools of a civil war that shakes the party's fate. As the related keyword analysis shows, the feelings of the public and supporters are filled entirely with conflict, controversy, and concern. (‘문조털래유’와 ‘한강새똥돼주길’이라는 멸칭의 대전은 현재 대한민국 정치가 마주한 비극적 초상이다. 지지자들이 서로를 향해 퍼붓는 조롱과 혐오의 언어는 당의 명운을 흔드는 내전의 도구로 전락했다. 연관어 분석이 보여주듯 국민과 지지층이 느끼는 감정은 온통 갈등, 논란, 우려뿐이다.)

The president's choice to step back from party strife and focus on growth and state outcomes by putting the cabinet forward may be effective in the short term, but it will be difficult to fully preserve state momentum while neglecting the party's internal collapse. If the August party convention fails to shed the language of mockery and hate and transform into a policy-oriented party for the people's livelihood, the final report card of this leadership war will likely be the devastating outcome of losing the ability to govern. <<>> (대통령이 당의 정쟁에서 발을 빼고 내각을 앞세워 성장과 국정 성과에 집중하려는 선택은 단기적으로는 유효할 수 있으나, 여당 내부의 파국을 방치한 채 국정 동력만 온전히 보존되기는 어렵다. 8월 전당대회가 조롱과 혐오의 언어를 걷어내고 민생을 위한 정책 정당으로 거듭나지 못한다면, 이번 당권 전쟁의 최종 성적표는 정권 가동 능력의 상실이라는 참혹한 결과로 귀결될 것이다.)

item.title: Chief Civil Secretary Han Chan-sik, Chief Social Secretary Kim Kyung-ja, Chief Communications Secretary Seong Ki-hong (민정수석 한찬식·사회수석 김경자·홍보수석 성기홍)
item.description:
Chief Civil Secretary Han Chan-sik, Chief Social Secretary Kim Kyung-ja, Chief Communications Secretary Seong Ki-hong (민정수석 한찬식·사회수석 김경자·홍보수석 성기홍)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 21st appointed Han Chan-sik (58), a lawyer from Kim & Chang Law Firm, as the Chief Civil Secretary at the Blue House. The new Chief Secretary, a former prosecutor, oversaw the "Ministry of Environment blacklist" case during the Moon Jae-in administration (2018-2019) while serving as the head of the Seoul Eastern District Prosecutors' Office, which led to the indictment of numerous Moon Jae-in administration officials in succession. (이재명 대통령은 21일 청와대 민정수석비서관에 한찬식(58) 김앤장법률사무소 변호사를 임명했다. 검사 출신인 한 신임 수석은 문재인 정부 시절인 2018~2019년 서울동부지검장으로 재직하면서 문재인 정부 인사들을 줄줄이 기소한 ‘환경부 블랙리스트’ 사건을 지휘했다.)

President Lee appointed Chief Secretary Han as the successor to former Chief Civil Secretary Bong-wook, who came from the prosecution, as announced by Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik during a Blue House briefing. Chief of Staff Kang stated about Chief Secretary Han, "He is a legal professional who has accumulated a balanced sense of strict law enforcement and human rights sensitivity while serving in leadership positions at frontline prosecutors' offices," adding, "He will complete the reform of the prosecution without a hitch, including the establishment of the Serious Crime Investigation Agency and the Corruption Investigation Office in the second year of the administration." (이 대통령은 이날 검찰 출신 봉욱 민정수석 후임으로 한 수석을 임명했다고 강훈식 비서실장이 청와대 브리핑에서 밝혔다. 강 실장은 한 수석에 대해 “일선 검찰청의 지휘부를 거치면서 법 집행의 엄정성과 인권 감수성을 균형감 있게 축적해 온 법조인”이라며 “국정 2년차 중대범죄수사청과 공수청 신설 등 검찰 개혁을 차질 없이 완수할 것”이라고 했다.)

However, immediately after the announcement, criticism emerged from the pro-Moon faction within the ruling party and the hardline support base, questioning "another prosecutor?" They opposed the appointment as an "anti-reform personnel choice," citing Chief Secretary Han's past history of investigating the Moon Jae-in administration and his background at Kim & Chang Law Firm. The fact that former Minister of Environment Kim Eun-kyung of the Moon Jae-in administration was sentenced to two years in prison as a result of the "Ministry of Environment blacklist" case overseen by Chief Secretary Han also resurfaced. On pro-government communities like Kim Eo-joon's "Ddanji Ilbo" bulletin board, some fiery responses emerged, such as "At this rate, isn't the President trying to pick a fight?" (그러나 발표 직후 여권 내 친문 진영과 강성 지지층에선 “또 검사 출신이냐”는 비판과 함께, 한 수석의 과거 문재인 정부 수사 이력과 김앤장법률사무소 출신이라는 점 등을 들어 “반(反)개혁적 인사”라는 반발이 이어졌다. 한 수석이 지휘했던 ‘환경부 블랙리스트’ 사건으로 문재인 정부의 김은경 전 환경부 장관이 징역 2년을 선고 받은 사실도 회자됐다. 김어준씨의 ‘딴지일보’ 게시판 등 친여 커뮤니티에선 “이쯤 되면 대통령이 싸우자고 하는 것 아니냐”는 격앙된 반응도 나왔다.)

This Blue House personnel appointment coincides with the second year of the Lee Jae-myung administration. Chief of Staff Kang stated, "This is a medium-to-large-scale reshuffle of Blue House personnel," and added, "It is an expression of our will to pursue more reforms and not slacken in self-criticism." (이번 청와대 인사는 이재명 정부 출범 2년차를 맞은 데 따른 것이다. 강 실장은 “중폭 이상의 청와대 인사 개편”이라며 “좀 더 개혁하고 좀 더 우리 스스로를 채찍질하는 데 게을리하지 않겠다는 의지의 표명”이라고 했다.)

President Lee appointed Seong Ki-hong, former CEO and President of Yonhap News Agency and a former journalist, as the Chief Communications Secretary, and Kim Kyung-ja, a former senior vice chairperson of the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions and an adjunct professor at the College of Liberal Arts at Woosuk University, as the Chief Social Secretary. As the first deputy director under the National Security Office, Kang Geon-jak, a member of the Presidential Committee on Future Defense Strategy who previously served as the commander of the 6th Corps, was appointed, and as the third deputy director, Song Ki-ho, a former Blue House economic security secretary, was appointed. Nam Jae-heon, the current head of the Arctic Route Promotion Headquarters at the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, was appointed as the Vice Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. (이 대통령은 홍보소통수석에 기자 출신인 성기홍 전 연합뉴스 대표이사 사장, 사회수석에는 민주노총 수석부위원장 출신인 김경자 우석대 교양대학 객원교수를 임명했다. 국가안보실 산하 1차장엔 6군단장 등을 지낸 강건작 대통령직속 미래국방전략위 위원, 3차장엔 송기호 청와대 경제안보비서관이 임명됐다. 해양수산부 차관에는 남재헌 현 해수부 북극항로추진본부장이 임명됐다.)

item.title: ‘Salmon Soirée False’ Ruling Weakens Claims of Fabricated Indictment… Ruling Party Says “Continue Special Counsel” (‘술파티 허위’ 판결로 조작기소 주장 힘 잃어… 與는 “특검 계속”)
item.description:
‘Salmon Soirée False’ Ruling Weakens Claims of Fabricated Indictment… Ruling Party Says “Continue Special Counsel” (‘술파티 허위’ 판결로 조작기소 주장 힘 잃어… 與는 “특검 계속”)

Although the first trial court concluded that the claims about a ‘salmon drinking party’ made by former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor Lee Hwa-young were false, the Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 21st that it would continue to push for a so-called ‘special counsel for fabricated indictments.’ (이화영 전 경기 부지사가 주장했던 ‘연어 술 파티’ 의혹에 대해 1심 법원이 ‘허위’라는 결론을 내렸지만, 더불어민주당은 21일 이른바 ‘조작기소 특검’을 계속 추진하겠다고 밝혔다.)

The ‘salmon drinking party’ allegations were the main basis for the Democratic Party's claim that the ‘remittance to North Korea case,’ for which Lee Hwa-young and President Lee Jae-myung were indicted, was fabricated. Legal circles assess that with the first trial court finding Lee Hwa-young guilty of perjury before the National Assembly and sentencing him to four months in prison, the Democratic Party's arguments have lost momentum. (‘연어 술 파티’ 의혹은 민주당이 이화영씨와 이재명 대통령이 기소된 ‘대북송금 사건’이 조작됐다고 주장하는 가장 주요한 근거였다. 1심 법원이 이화영씨의 국회 위증 혐의를 인정해 징역 4개월을 선고하면서, 민주당 주장에 힘이 빠졌다는 게 법조계 평가다.)

However, Democratic Party figures argued, “Since 3 out of 7 jurors gave a verdict of not guilty, the substance is not guilty,” insisting that if the trial had been held after a special counsel investigation, an acquittal would have been reached. One legal expert said, “The Democratic Party has taken the stance that not only the North Korea remittance case but also all cases for which President Lee was indicted are ‘fabricated.’ It will be difficult for them to stop now.” (하지만 민주당 인사들은 “배심원(7명) 중 3명이 무죄 의견을 냈으니 실질은 무죄”라면서 특검 수사 뒤에 재판을 했으면 무죄가 선고됐을 것이라고 주장했다. 한 법조인은 “민주당은 대북 송금 사건뿐 아니라 이 대통령이 기소된 모든 사건이 ‘조작’이라는 입장을 취해 왔다”며 “이제와 멈추기는 힘들 것”이라고 했다.)

Lee first raised the salmon drinking party allegations in April 2024 during his own trial for the North Korea remittance case. He claimed that the prosecution had gathered former Ssangbangwool Group Chairman Kim Seong-tae, former Vice Chairman Bang Yong-cheol, and others in Room 1313 of the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office, treating them to alcohol and sliced raw salmon while holding a ‘statement seminar’ to frame President Lee Jae-myung. (이씨가 연어 술 파티 의혹을 처음 제기한 것은 2024년 4월 자신의 대북송금 사건 재판에서다. 검찰이 이재명 대통령을 엮기 위해 쌍방울그룹 김성태 전 회장, 방용철 전 부회장 등을 수원지검 1313호에 모아놓고 술과 연어회 등을 대접하며 ‘진술 세미나’를 했다는 것이다.)

At the time, the Democratic Party treated this as fact and immediately paid protest visits to the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office, and the Suwon Detention Center. Although Lee subsequently changed his statements repeatedly regarding the time, place, and whether he himself drank alcohol, the Democratic Party continued to assert that the prosecution's investigation was fabricated. (민주당은 당시 이를 사실로 단정하고 즉각 대검과 수원지검, 수원구치소를 항의 방문했다. 이후 이씨가 술자리 일시, 장소, 본인의 음주 여부 등에 대해 계속 진술을 번복했지만, 민주당은 검찰 수사가 조작됐다는 주장을 이어 갔다.)

In June 2024, during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, the Democratic Party proposed a special bill for a ‘special counsel to uncover the truth behind the prosecution's coercion of false statements from Lee Hwa-young and Kim Seong-tae,’ and in July of the same year, it also proposed an impeachment motion against prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who investigated Lee. A hearing for the impeachment of prosecutor Park Sang-yong was held in the National Assembly in October 2024. Appearing as a witness at this hearing, Lee claimed, “Ssangbangwool employees repeatedly held a ‘statement seminar’ to align their statements, and foods like short rib soup, jajangmyeon, and salmon were provided.” The first trial court ruled that this testimony constituted perjury and sentenced him to four months in prison. (민주당은 윤석열 정부 때인 2024년 6월 ‘이화영·김성태에 대한 검찰의 허위 진술 강요 진상규명’ 특검법을 발의했고, 같은 해 7월에는 이씨를 수사한 박상용 검사에 대한 탄핵안도 발의했다. 2024년 10월 국회에서는 박상용 검사 탄핵소추를 위한 청문회가 열렸다. 이씨는 이 청문회에 증인으로 출석해 “쌍방울 직원들이 서로 진술을 맞추는 ‘진술 세미나’가 반복됐고 갈비탕, 짜장면, 연어 등이 제공됐다”고 주장했다. 이번에 1심 법원은 이 증언이 위증이라고 판단하고 징역 4개월을 선고했다.)

After the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the Democratic Party's offensive intensified further. In March, the Democratic Party pushed for a parliamentary investigation into seven cases, including the North Korea remittance case, calling them ‘fabricated indictments by the Yoon Suk-yeol regime's political prosecutors.’ Again, Lee's ‘salmon drinking party’ claims served as the main material. In April, members of the Democratic Party's parliamentary investigation special committee even bought soju at a convenience store near the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office, checked the walking distance to the office building, and then claimed, “The salmon drinking party allegations have been confirmed.” (이재명 정부 출범 이후 민주당의 공세는 더 거세졌다. 민주당은 지난 3월 대북송금 사건 등 7개 사건에 대해 ‘윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소’ 국정조사를 추진했다. 이때도 이씨의 ‘연어 술 파티’ 주장이 주된 소재였다. 지난 4월 민주당 국조특위 위원들은 수원지검 인근 편의점에서 소주를 구매해 청사까지 이동 거리를 확인한 뒤 “연어 술 파티 의혹이 확인됐다”고 주장하기도 했다.)

However, witnesses who appeared at the parliamentary investigation hearing gave testimony differing from Lee's. Former Chairman Kim Seong-tae stated, “I clearly tell you, I did not drink alcohol.” Park Sang-woong, a former Ssangbangwool director suspected of purchasing four bottles of soju at a convenience store near the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office and bringing them into the office building, also said, “I bought them to drink personally, and I drank them inside the car.” In response, the Democratic Party reported these individuals to the police on charges of perjury. (하지만 국정조사 청문회에 출석한 증인들은 이씨와 다른 증언을 했다. 김성태 전 회장은 “분명히 말씀드리지만 술 안 먹었다”고 했고, 수원지검 인근 편의점에서 소주 4병을 구매해 청사 안으로 반입했다는 의혹을 받은 박상웅 전 쌍방울 이사도 “개인적으로 마시려고 샀고 차 안에서 먹었다”고 했다. 그러자 민주당은 이들을 위증 혐의로 경찰에 고발했다.)

Regarding the court's decision on the 20th that the ‘salmon drinking party’ claims were false, the Democratic Party said, “An acquittal will be handed down in the appeals trial.” Members of the parliamentary investigation special committee argued at a press conference on the 21st, “This verdict outcome cannot be seen as having reached proof to the extent that there is no reasonable doubt.” Committee chairperson Rep. Seo Young-kyo also stated, “The court led the trial in a narrow-minded way, resulting in a close 4-3 opinion.” Democratic Party lawmakers insisted on introducing a special counsel, arguing, “If a special counsel investigation had been introduced and carried out, there would be no reason for the current 4-3 debate, and an acquittal would have been pronounced.” One legal expert commented, “It seems they will keep going until they get a result they like,” and added, “I am concerned about the pressure being placed on the court.” (민주당은 20일 법원이 ‘연어 술 파티’ 주장을 허위라고 판단한 것에 대해 “항소심에선 무죄가 선고될 것”이라고 했다. 국조특위 위원들은 21일 기자회견에서 “이번 평결 결과는 ‘합리적 의심이 없는 정도로 증명에 이르렀다’고 볼 수 없다”고 주장했다. 국조특위 위원장인 서영교 의원은 “재판부가 편협되게 재판을 이끌어나가면서 4대3 의견으로 팽팽해진 것”이라고도 했다. 민주당 의원들은 “특검이 도입되고 수사하면 지금 4대3 논란이 빚어질 이유도 없이 무죄가 선고됐을 것”이라면서 특검 도입을 주장했다. 한 법조인은 “마음에 드는 결론이 나올 때까지 하겠다는 것”이라며 “법원에 대한 압박이 우려된다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae’s Candidacy Imminent… Pro-Lee Faction Keeps Criticizing (정청래 출마 임박… 친명은 연일 비판)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae’s Candidacy Imminent… Pro-Lee Faction Keeps Criticizing (정청래 출마 임박… 친명은 연일 비판)

Amid expectations that Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae will formally announce his bid for re-election this week, internal pressure for him to step aside continues. As the party’s August convention takes shape with a showdown between Jung and candidates backed by the pro-Lee faction—Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil—the ruling bloc appears split just one year into the Lee Jae-myung administration. <<> Over the weekend, Jung visited Haenam, Jangheung, Suncheon, and Damyang in South Jeolla Province to engage with party members. The day before, he toured Iksan, Jeonju, and Gunsan in North Jeolla Province. Honam, a traditional Democratic stronghold, holds the largest concentration of party members, and the next party leader is effectively decided by their votes. Jung is expected to announce his re-election bid around the 24th, and his tour of Honam is seen as an effort to gauge member sentiment. <<> Jung and party leadership contender Prime Minister Kim Min-seok attended a workshop for winners of the June 3 local elections at the National Assembly on the 21st. Jung stated, “The party’s goal is the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the reclamation of power, and turning South Korea into an unshakable advanced nation.” Kim said, “I will contribute to ensuring the party and government are perfectly united and that the Democratic Party can leap forward to win again.” A party insider described a “subtle tension” between the two. <<> Another potential leadership candidate, lawmaker Song Young-gil, appeared on KBC Gwangju Broadcasting on the same day and explicitly called on Jung not to run, saying, “Jung is running to confront the president head-on.” Both Kim and Song argue that Jung’s leadership should take responsibility for the failure to secure a landslide victory in the recent local elections. <<> Criticism of Jung’s re-election bid has been cross-factional. Lawmaker Park Beom-kye said, “With policies and results unchanged, approval ratings have plummeted,” while lawmaker Jo Gye-won remarked, “Jung’s focus on re-election through a divisive ‘showcase politics’ is pitiful.” (더불어민주당 정청래 대표가 이번 주 연임 도전을 공식화할 것으로 보이는 가운데, 당내 불출마 압박이 이어지고 있다. 8월 민주당 전당대회가 정 대표와 친명계가 미는 김민석 국무총리, 송영길 의원 등의 대결 구도로 형성되면서, 여권이 이재명 정부 출범 1년 만에 두 쪽으로 분열되는 양상이다.)

item.title: Social Affairs Senior Secretary from Democratic Union of Labor Unions' Vice Chair… Public Relations Senior Secretary Served as Yonhap News Agency President (사회수석, 민노총 부위원장 출신… 홍보수석은 연합뉴스 사장 지내)
item.description:
Social Affairs Senior Secretary from Democratic Union of Labor Unions' Vice Chair… Public Relations Senior Secretary Served as Yonhap News Agency President (사회수석, 민노총 부위원장 출신… 홍보수석은 연합뉴스 사장 지내)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 21st appointed new Senior Secretaries for Public Relations and Communication, Civil Affairs, Social Affairs, and the First and Third Deputy Directors of the National Security Office. (이재명 대통령이 21일 청와대 홍보소통수석과 민정수석, 사회수석 및 국가안보실 1·3차장을 새로 임명했다.)

Sung Ki-hong, former president of Yonhap News Agency, was appointed as the new Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication. Senior Secretary Sung, a former journalist, served as political news editor, editorial writer at Yonhap News, and news director at Yonhap News TV. He also served as president of Yonhap News Agency and Yonhap News TV for three years starting in 2021. <<> Kim Kyung-ja, a visiting professor at the College of General Education at Woosuk University and a former member of the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU), was appointed as the Senior Secretary for Social Affairs. In 1995, she served as the head of the Inha Hospital branch of the National Hospital Workers' Union Federation. She is known to have forged a connection with President Lee during the movement to establish Seongnam Medical Center following the closure of Inha Hospital. At that time, President Lee, a former lawyer based in Seongnam, was active in civic organizations. The new Senior Secretary Kim served as Senior Vice Chair of the KCTU for three years starting in 2017, during the Moon Jae-in administration. In 2019, when then-KCTU Chair Kim Myung-hwan was arrested on charges of leading illegal activities at a rally in front of the National Assembly, she served as acting chair in her capacity as Senior Vice Chair. <<> President Lee selected Kang Gun-jak, a current member of the Future National Defense Strategy Committee under the President, as the First Deputy Director of the National Security Office. After serving as commander of the Army's 28th Infantry Division, he served as director of the National Crisis Management Center at the National Security Office under the Moon Jae-in government, followed by a role as senior presidential secretary for defense reform, where he was involved in efforts to push for the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON). He retired as a lieutenant general in 2023 after serving as commander of the Army's 6th Corps. Under the Lee Jae-myung administration, he was appointed as a civilian member of the Presidential Future National Defense Strategy Committee. In his book "The Conditions for a Strong Military for a Renewed South Korean Armed Forces," published last year, he once again emphasized the need for the OPCON transition. <<> Song Ki-ho, the economic security secretary, was appointed as the Third Deputy Director of the National Security Office. He ran as a candidate for the National Assembly in Seoul's Songpa District B in the 2024 general election but lost. However, he was surprisingly selected in June of last year as the first director of the State Affairs Situation Room under the Lee Jae-myung administration. Later, as tariff negotiations with the United States unfolded in July last year, he moved to the position of economic security secretary under the National Security Office, handling international trade and commerce affairs. Deputy Director Song is a graduate of the Judicial Research and Training Institute (30th class) and has served as chair of the international trade committee in the Lawyers for a Democratic Society (Minbyun). <<> Meanwhile, Nam Jae-heon, current head of the Arctic Route Promotion Headquarters at the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, was appointed as Vice Minister of Oceans and Fisheries on the same day. Entering public service through the 34th round of the technical civil service examination, he has served as head of the Busan North Port Integrated Development Promotion Team, head of the Masan Regional Office of Oceans and Fisheries, and director of the Ports Bureau. (새 홍보소통수석에는 성기홍 전 연합뉴스 사장이 임명됐다. 성 수석은 기자 출신으로 연합뉴스에서 정치부장, 논설위원과 연합뉴스TV 보도국장을 역임했다. 2021년부터 3년 동안은 연합뉴스 및 연합뉴스TV 사장으로 재직했다.)

item.title: Han Chan-sik's Appointment as Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs Sparks Backlash: Some Supporters Cry 'Betrayal' and 'Provocation' (‘文정부 수사’ 한찬식 발탁에… 與지지층 일부 “배신·도발”)
item.description:
Han Chan-sik's Appointment as Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs Sparks Backlash: Some Supporters Cry 'Betrayal' and 'Provocation' (‘文정부 수사’ 한찬식 발탁에… 與지지층 일부 “배신·도발”)

When President Lee Jae-myung appointed Han Chan-sik, a former prosecutor-turned-lawyer at Kim & Chang, as the new Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs on the 21st, strong backlash erupted from within the ruling party's support base, with reactions like "Another prosecutor?" and "A betrayal of prosecutorial reform." Supporters took issue with Han’s background as a former prosecutor who led an investigation into the so-called "Ministry of Environment blacklist" targeting the Moon Jae-in administration, as well as being the son-in-law of the late Choi Byung-ryeol, former Grand National Party leader, labeling it "an utterly unacceptable appointment." Amid the Democratic Party's internal division into pro-Lee and pro-Jeong factions ahead of the August party convention to elect a new leader, the ruling party's rift appears to be deepening. <<> President Lee appointed another former high-ranking prosecutor to the post of Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs, following former secretaries Oh Kwang-soo and Bong Wook. Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik explained, "Secretary Han will flawlessly complete prosecutorial reforms, including the establishment of the Major Crimes Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Office." A senior official at the presidential office also stated, "Wasn't excluding prosecutors in the past government ultimately the cause of reform failure? Former prosecutors can reform both the prosecutorial organization and prosecutors themselves." <<> It is reported that Secretary Han will commence follow-up work on the reorganization of investigative powers, including the establishment of the Public Prosecution Office under the abolition of the Supreme Prosecutors' Office in October and issues surrounding prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority. A ruling party source said, "What the president seeks is not a 'collapse of the prosecution.' While he says the supplementary investigation authority issue will be left to the National Assembly, he still maintains that at least minimal supplementary measures are necessary." Han graduated from Seoul National University's College of Law and began his career as a prosecutor at the Seoul District Prosecutors' Office. He served as head of the First Advanced Crime Investigation Division at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office, spokesperson for the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, director of the Human Rights Bureau at the Ministry of Justice, and later as chief prosecutor of the Ulsan, Suwon, and Seoul Eastern District Prosecutors' Offices before leaving the prosecution service. <<> Following the president's announcement of Han's appointment, criticism poured in from the ruling party's support base, with comments such as "Appointing a 'Moon Jae-in sniper' as Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs is a provocation ignoring Democratic Party supporters" and "Another Kim & Chang appointment after Bong Wook." While serving as chief prosecutor of the Seoul Eastern District Prosecutors' Office under the Moon Jae-in administration, Han oversaw the 'Ministry of Environment blacklist' case. The investigation led to the prosecution of former Environment Minister Kim Eun-kyung, appointed by President Moon, and former Presidential Secretary for Balanced Personnel Shin Mi-sook. Former Minister Kim was later sentenced to two years in prison by the Supreme Court. Pro-government online communities like Kim Eo-joon's Ddanzi Ilbo and Clien were flooded with unrestrained criticism of President Lee, including claims like "The president abandoned prosecutorial reform to have his own case dropped" and "He made a deal with the prosecution for safety after leaving office." <<> The division within the ruling party's support base has deepened since the June 3 local elections. After the Democratic Party failed to recapture the Seoul mayoralty, supporters of pro-Lee and pro-Jeong factions have split over the issue of accountability for the Jeong Cheong-rae leadership, exacerbated by the upcoming August party convention. In particular, a noticeable split is emerging between the so-called "New Lee Jae-myung" group, which began supporting President Lee around the last presidential election, and the traditional "pro-Roh, pro-Moon" faction of the Democratic Party. The "New Lee Jae-myung" group tends to favor Prime Minister Kim Min-seok as the next party leader, while the traditional support base largely backs Representative Jeong Cheong-rae. Amid this, the president's appointment on this day appears to be pouring fuel on the fire of internal ruling party conflict. Within the "New Lee Jae-myung" camp, reactions include "We must not doubt the president's reform will" and "It's only the second year of his term; we should trust the president." However, from the traditional support base, comments emerged such as "The president blatantly intervened in party affairs by suggesting we vote for Kim Min-seok as the next leader, and now he's pushing forward with someone who targeted the Moon Jae-in administration to pick a fight." <<> The Democratic Party issued no comment on the presidential office's appointment announcement that day. A party official stated, "Typically, a briefing supporting the president's decision would be released, but we're taking a wait-and-see approach based on reactions from the support base." The Rebuilding Korea Party, largely composed of figures from the Moon Jae-in administration, expressed through a spokesperson's statement: "Ahead of the second phase of prosecutorial reform discussions on supplementary investigation authority and full-case transfer issues, the appointment of Secretary Han is deeply concerning." Jeong Choon-saeng, a lawmaker from the Rebuilding Korea Party and former Democratic Party member, wrote on social media, "It's hard to understand the appointment of Secretary Han. Please, let us continue to support [the president]."" (이재명 대통령이 21일 청와대 신임 민정수석에 검사 출신 한찬식 김앤장법률사무소 변호사를 임명하자, 여권 지지층에서는 “또 검사냐” “검찰 개혁에 대한 배신”이라는 강한 반발이 터져 나왔다. 지지자들은 한 수석이 문재인 정부 때 정권을 겨냥한 ‘환경부 블랙리스트’ 수사를 지휘한 검사 출신이라는 점, 고(故) 최병렬 전 한나라당 대표의 사위라는 점 등을 문제 삼아 “도저히 받아들일 수 없는 인사”라고 했다. 민주당 내부가 차기 당대표를 뽑는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 친명, 친청 둘로 쪼개지는 상황에서 여권 분열이 가속화하는 모양새다.)

item.title: Defense Ministry's 'Plan to Merge Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies'... Military Insiders and Outsiders Allege "Hasty Restructuring to Erase the Army Academy" (국방부 ‘육·해·공사 통합안’에 … 軍안팎 “육사 지우려 졸속 개편”)
item.description:
Defense Ministry's 'Plan to Merge Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies'... Military Insiders and Outsiders Allege "Hasty Restructuring to Erase the Army Academy" (국방부 ‘육·해·공사 통합안’에 … 軍안팎 “육사 지우려 졸속 개편”)

Concerns and opposition are spreading both within and outside the military regarding the Defense Ministry's accelerated push to 'merge the Army, Navy, and Air Force officer academies.' The merger of the officer academies is a campaign pledge of President Lee Jae-myung. (국방부가 속도를 내고 있는 ‘육·해·공군 사관학교 통합’을 놓고 군 안팎의 우려와 반발이 확산하고 있다. 사관학교 통합은 이재명 대통령의 대선 공약이다.)

The core of the backlash centers on it being a "hasty push." Some suspect it is a move to "erase the Army Academy" using the involvement of Army Academy graduates in the 'December 3 martial law incident' as a pretext. (반발의 핵심은 “졸속 추진”이라는 것이다. 일부에서는 육사 출신 군인의 ‘12·3 비상계엄 관여’를 빌미로 ‘육사 지우기’에 나선 것이라고 의심한다.)

On the National Assembly's electronic petition website, as of the 21st, a petition calling for the "halt of the consolidation and relocation of the Army Academy" has garnered over 50,000 agreements. The petition states, "This is an issue that could significantly impact national security and the entire military education system," and warns that "a hasty reorganization could potentially weaken national defense capabilities." If the petition's agreements surpass 50,000, the relevant standing committee of the National Assembly will review it. (국회 전자청원 홈페이지에는 ‘육군 사관학교 통폐합과 지방 이전을 중단해달라’는 취지의 청원에 대한 동의 수가 21일까지 5만명을 넘었다. 청원은 “국가 안보와 군 교육 체계 전반에 중대한 영향을 미칠 수 있는 사안”이라며 “졸속 개편은 국가안보 역량 약화를 초래할 가능성이 크다”고 했다. 청원 동의가 5만명을 넘으면, 관련 국회 상임위에서 해당 청원을 다룬다.)

The government's integration plan centers on merging the existing Army, Navy, and Air Force academies into a single 'National Military Academy.' It follows a '2+2 model,' where freshmen and sophomores receive common foundational education, while juniors and seniors split into the Army, Navy, or Air Force for specialized advanced courses. The Defense Ministry is expected to announce its final plan as early as next month. Minister Ahn Kyu-baek has been visiting each academy since last month to gather cadets' opinions. (정부의 통합안은 기존 육·해·공군 사관학교를 합쳐 ‘국군 사관학교’를 만드는 것이 핵심이다. 국군 사관학교 1~2학년은 공통 기초 소양을 같이 교육받고, 3~4학년은 육·해·공군을 나눠 전공 심화 과정을 다루는 ‘2+2 방식’이다. 국방부는 이르면 다음 달쯤 최종안을 발표할 예정이다. 안규백 장관은 지난달부터 육·해·공사를 차례로 찾아 생도들에게 의견을 들었다.)

National defense experts worry that "premature integrated education could undermine the expertise and diversity of each service branch." Joo Eun-sik, head of the Korea Research Institute for Strategy (a retired brigadier general), said, "Even basic courses need to be tailored to each service's characteristics—such as 'field leadership' for the Army, 'oceanography' for the Navy, and 'aerodynamics' for the Air Force. But in a merged academy, the first two years are highly likely to be operated inefficiently." (국방 전문가들은 “섣부른 통합성 교육은 각 군의 전문성, 다양성을 해칠 수 있다”고 우려한다. 주은식 한국전략문제연구소장(예비역 준장)은 “기초 과정도 육군은 ‘야전 리더십’, 해군은 ‘해양학’, 공군은 ‘항공 역학’ 등으로 각군 특성에 맞게 짜여져야 하는데, 통합 사관학교는 첫 2년이 비효율적으로 운영될 가능성이 크다”고 했다.)

As it becomes known that the Army's junior and senior courses are being considered for relocation not to the current Army Academy site in Taereung, Seoul, but in Jangseong County, South Jeolla Province, internal opposition within the Army Academy is also growing. A retired officer who is an Academy graduate said, "I see this as driven by animosity toward the Army Academy." (육군의 3~4학년 과정이 현재 육사가 있는 서울 태릉이 아니라 전남 장성군에서 진행되는 방안이 검토되는 것으로 알려지면서, 육사 내부의 반발도 커지고 있다. 한 육사 출신 예비역은 “육사에 대한 반감이 작용한 것으로 본다”고 했다.)

The Army Academy Alumni Association released a statement on the 16th regarding the merger plan, declaring, "We strongly appeal for the initiation of a transparent and objective public deliberation process from square one." On the same day, 13 former Army Chiefs of Staff, including former Chief of Staff Do Il-gyu, issued a joint statement saying, "We are concerned about a likely decline in securing talented personnel and educational competitiveness. The history and traditions of the officer academies must be respected." (육사 총동창회는 지난 16일 입장문을 내고 사관학교 통합안에 대해 “원점에서부터 투명하고 객관적인 공론화 과정을 시작할 것을 강력히 호소한다”고 밝혔다. 도일규 전 육군참모총장 등 전직 육참총장 13명은 같은 날 공동 성명에서 “우수 인재 확보와 교육 경쟁력 약화가 우려되며, 사관학교의 역사와 전통이 존중돼야 한다”고 했다.)

A Defense Ministry official said, "The plan to merge the officer academies has not yet been finalized," adding, "We will develop a plan to transform them into premier educational institutions and explain it to the public." (국방부 관계자는 “사관학교 통합 방안은 아직 확정되지 않았다”며 “최고의 교육 기관으로 거듭날 수 있는 방안을 마련해 국민들께 설명드릴 예정”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Jang to Strengthen Party Control? Considering Key Appointments (張, 당권 더 강화? 당직 인사 만지작)
item.description:
Jang to Strengthen Party Control? Considering Key Appointments (張, 당권 더 강화? 당직 인사 만지작)

People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who is facing calls to resign after the June 3 local elections defeat, is reportedly reviewing key party appointments as of the 21st. Jang, currently hospitalized due to overwork, is expected to return to party affairs this week and implement some reshuffling of party positions. This move is seen as an attempt to further strengthen the current pro-leadership faction’s grip on the party, which could escalate tensions between the leadership and reformist factions if carried out. <<> According to a comprehensive report by this newspaper, Jang is reportedly considering a reshuffle that includes appointing a new policy committee chair—a position left vacant after the election of floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik—along with replacing Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong and the deputy secretary-general team. Media spokespersons whose terms have expired are also said to be under review for replacement. A source close to Jang stated, “As we wrap up the local elections, there is considerable discussion about personnel reshuffles within the party,” adding, “We are carefully weighing the pros and cons of various replacements.” <<> For the new policy committee chair, candidates reportedly include three-term lawmaker Kim Jeong-jae, and two-term lawmakers Park Soo-young, Kim Eun-hye, and Yoo Sang-beom. These individuals are generally seen as having ties to the pro-Yoon faction. According to party rules, the authority to appoint the policy committee chair lies with the party leader, but since the chair must work closely with the floor leader, it is customary to consult and reach an agreement through the floor leader’s recommendation. A key floor leadership source said, “While we are considering candidates among three-term lawmakers, the appointment depends on the formation of the opposition and ruling party’s assembly lineup, as it is linked to standing committee chair positions.” <<> On the same day, the PPP released a press statement emphasizing that “Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk devoted himself entirely to covering all 16 cities and provinces during the June 3 local elections to ensure the victory of candidates.” The statement also noted, “Compared to the 2018 local elections, the number of elected officials increased by 2 metropolitan mayors, 42 district mayors, 191 metropolitan council members, and 268 district council members.” <<> In response, floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik appeared on MBN later that day and distanced himself from the statement, saying, “This is an analysis from the party secretariat that I was not briefed on beforehand and does not fully reflect the opinions of lawmakers.” <<> Separately, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon stated in an interview with Japan’s Yomiuri Shimbun the previous day that, when asked about the difficulty of returning to the party under Jang’s leadership, “Jang is merely maintaining his position formally; he has already lost his political authority and legitimacy to lead the conservative camp.” In response to whether he would pursue returning to the PPP or forming a new conservative coalition, Han said, “My goal is to return to the PPP,” but added, “There is no need to rush.” (6·3 지방선거 패배 이후 사퇴 요구에 직면해 있는 국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 주요 당직 인사를 검토 중인 것으로 21일 전해졌다. 과로로 입원 중인 장 대표가 이번 주 당무에 복귀하면서 일부 당직 개편을 한다는 것이다. 현 당권파의 당 장악력을 더 강화하겠다는 의미여서 실행될 경우 당권파와 쇄신파 간의 갈등이 또다시 격화할 전망이다.)

item.title: “Reforming the Election Commission: An Independent Audit Body is More Realistic than Constitutional Amendment” (“선관위 쇄신, 개헌보다는 독립적 감사 기구가 현실적”)
item.description:
“Reforming the Election Commission: An Independent Audit Body is More Realistic than Constitutional Amendment” (“선관위 쇄신, 개헌보다는 독립적 감사 기구가 현실적”)

Yoon Sang-hyun (Incheon Dong-gu, Michuhol-gu), a lawmaker from the People Power Party appointed as chair of the National Assembly’s special investigation committee into the ballot shortage incident, described the National Election Commission (NEC) on the 21st as a “Galapagos out of touch with public perception.” Chair Yoon stated, “Even corruption and incompetence that astonishes the entire nation seem trivial to NEC employees,” and added, “I will thoroughly investigate everything, from on-site election management, personnel systems, organizational operations, to decision-making structures during this opportunity.” He also proposed, “Let civic groups participate as well, and jointly verify even allegations of election fraud.” This parliamentary investigation will be conducted for 45 days until August 1st. (투표용지 부족 사태 국회 국정조사 특별위원회 위원장에 임명된 국민의힘 윤상현(인천 동·미추홀을) 의원은 21일 선거관리위원회를 “국민 인식과 동떨어진 갈라파고스”라고 했다. 윤 위원장은 “온 국민이 경악할 만한 비리·부실도 선관위 직원들은 대수롭지 않게 생각하는 것 같다”며 “이 기회에 선거 현장 관리, 인사 체계, 조직 운영, 의사 결정 구조까지 모조리 파헤치겠다”고 했다. “시민단체도 참여해 부정선거(주장)까지 다같이 검증해보자”고도 했다. 이번 국정조사는 8월 1일까지 45일간 실시된다.)

Regarding oversight of the NEC, Chair Yoon proposed establishing a permanent external audit committee within the central NEC, recommended by the National Assembly, as an independent body. Last year, the Constitutional Court ruled that the Board of Audit and Inspection, which falls under the president’s authority according to the constitution, cannot audit the duties of the NEC, a constitutional institution. This has led to calls within the ruling bloc for a constitutional amendment to oversee the NEC. However, Chair Yoon noted, “Constitutional amendment takes too much time,” and deemed the creation of an independent body obligated to report to the National Assembly as a better alternative. (윤 위원장은 선관위 감시 제도와 관련해 중앙선관위 내에 독립기구로 국회가 추천하는 상설 외부 감사위원회를 설치하자고 제안했다. 지난해 헌법재판소는 헌법상 대통령 소속인 감사원이 헌법기관인 선관위 직무를 감찰할 수 없다고 판결했고, 여권에선 선관위 감시를 위한 개헌 주장이 나온다. 하지만 윤 위원장은 “개헌은 너무 많은 시간이 걸린다”며 국회 보고 의무를 가진 독립기구 신설이 낫다고 봤다.)

– Public distrust in the NEC is intense. (－선관위에 대한 국민 불신이 거세다.)

“In 2024, nepotism in hiring was exposed, and NEC employees said, ‘The NEC is a family business.’ Don’t you think they appear to the public as people stuck on a Galapagos island? Even corruption and incompetence that shock the entire nation seem trivial to NEC employees. There’s no answer other than a sweeping, dismantle-level overhaul to reform the mindset of all 3,000 NEC employees.” (“2024년 가족 채용 비리가 터지고 선관위 직원들은 ‘선관위는 가족회사’라고 했다. 국민들 보시기에 완전히 갈라파고스 섬에 갇힌 사람들 같지 않겠나. 온 국민이 경악할 만한 비리·부실도 선관위 직원들은 대수롭지 않게 생각하는 것이다. 3000여 명 선관위 직원 전체의 의식을 뜯어고치는, 해체 수준의 대대적인 쇄신 외에는 답이 없다.”)

– This is the first parliamentary investigation into the NEC. Won’t the ruling and opposition parties just end up fighting again? (－선관위에 대한 첫 국정조사인데, 여야가 또 싸우는 거 아닌가.)

“In the first meeting last week, lawmakers from both parties promised to ‘uncover the truth, assign responsibility, improve the system, and avoid political strife at all costs.’ On the 23rd, we will receive a report from the NEC and plan to conduct an on-site inspection of the polling station in Jamsil, Songpa-gu, Seoul, where the ballot shortage occurred. Hearings for former Central NEC Chair Noh Tae-ak and acting Chair Wi Cheol-hwan will also be held soon. There will be no sacred cows. If they refuse to cooperate under the pretext of ongoing investigations or trials, we are even considering issuing warrants for compulsory appearance.” (“지난주 1차 회의에서 여야 위원들이 ‘진상규명 하겠다, 책임 소재 묻겠다, 제도 개선 하겠다, 정쟁(政爭)만큼은 하지 않겠다’고 약속했다. 23일 선관위 기관보고를 받고, 투표용지 부족 사태가 벌어졌던 서울 송파구 잠실 투표소 현장조사를 할 생각이다. 노태악 전 중앙선관위원장·위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행 등에 대한 청문회도 곧 열린다. 성역은 없다. 만약 수사·재판 중이라는 핑계로 국정조사에 불응하면 동행명령장 발부까지 생각하고 있다.”)

Chair Yoon also plans to form a separate “preliminary investigation team” of 6 to 8 external experts within the special investigative committee, aimed at gathering reform opinions for the NEC from an outside perspective. He stated, “If necessary, lawmakers from both parties will also engage in public discussions with the preliminary investigation team.” He added, “I hope civic groups will participate here as well, and we can jointly verify even allegations of election fraud during this opportunity.” (윤 위원장은 국정조사 특위에 6~8명 규모의 외부 전문가 중심의 ‘예비조사팀’도 따로 구성한다는 방침이다. 외부 시선으로 선관위 개혁 의견을 모으겠다는 것이다. 윤 위원장은 “필요하다면 여야 위원들이 예비조사팀과 공개토론에도 나서겠다”고 했다. 그러면서 “여기에 시민단체 분들도 참여했으면 한다”며 “이번 기회에 부정선거(주장)까지 다같이 검증해보자는 것”이라고 했다.)

– President Lee Jae-myung proposed a single-issue constitutional amendment for the NEC. (－이재명 대통령이 선관위 원포인트 개헌을 제안했다.)

“If the people want it, we should pursue constitutional amendments, special counsel investigations, and legal revisions. However, the priority is the fact-finding investigation. My personal view is that both the parliamentary investigation and the special counsel probe should be launched simultaneously. Isn’t a constitutional amendment a black hole that absorbs everything? It takes too long to reach a national consensus.” (“국민이 원한다면 개헌이든, 특검이든, 법 개정이든 다 해야 한다. 다만 진상 조사가 최우선이다. 국정조사와 특검부터 동시 가동해야 한다는 것이 개인적 생각이다. 개헌은 모든 것을 빨아들이는 블랙홀 아니겠나. 국민적 공감대에 이르기까지 너무 많은 시간이 걸린다.”)

– How can it be done without a constitutional amendment? (－개헌 없이 어떻게 할 수 있나.)

“I propose establishing a permanent external audit committee as an independent body within the NEC, through agreement between the ruling and opposition parties. It would conduct audits of the NEC and have an obligation to report to the National Assembly. This is possible with just legal revisions. Additionally, the reward system for reporting election crimes should have its cap raised to the maximum, and NEC employees should be included as recipients to enable whistleblowing internally.” (“여야 합의로 선관위 내에 독립기구인 ‘상설 외부 감사위원회’ 설치를 제안한다. 선관위 감사를 진행하고, 국회에 보고할 의무를 갖게 하자는 것이다. 법 개정만으로 가능하다. 선거 범죄 신고 포상금 제도 또한 상한액을 최대로 높이고 지급 대상에 선관위 직원들까지 포함해서 ‘내부고발’이 가능하게 고쳐야 한다.”)

– A Supreme Court justice concurrently serves as chair of the Central NEC. (－대법관이 중앙선관위원장을 겸직하고 있다.)

“Isn’t it essentially someone sitting at the Supreme Court most of the time, coming to the NEC about once a month just to stamp documents and then returning? Some NEC employees go on business trips to the Maldives, take leave every election season, and even engage in preferential hiring through ‘daddy’s privilege.’ Isn’t the chair just a figurehead? To command and supervise employees, the leadership must be full-time. The ruling and opposition parties will revise the NEC Act to definitely rectify the organizational structure first.” (“평소에 대법원에 앉아 있다가 한 달에 한 번꼴로 선관위에 나와서 고무도장만 찍어주고 다시 돌아간다는 것 아닌가. 일부 선관위 직원은 몰디브로 출장 가고, 선거철마다 휴직하고, ‘아빠 찬스’ 특혜 채용까지 저지른다. 일종의 꼭두각시 위원장 아닌가. 직원들을 지휘·감독하려면 기본적으로 지휘부가 상근직이 되어야 한다. 여야가 선관위법을 개정해 조직 구조부터 반드시 바로잡겠다.”)

– The anger over the ballot shortage has persisted for over two weeks. (－투표용지 부족에 대한 분노가 보름 넘게 계속되고 있다.)

“I went to two rallies at the Olympic Park. The anger of young people is fully justified. Isn’t this an unprecedented event that shakes the principle of popular sovereignty in Article 1 of the Constitution? The government should not show a repressive attitude by telling them ‘you could ruin yourself and your family.’ I will approach this with a sense of responsibility to embrace the demands of the people in the streets within the institutional framework.” (“두 차례 올림픽공원(집회)에 나갔다. 청년들 분노에는 충분한 이유가 있다. 헌법 1조 주권재민의 원칙을 뒤흔든 전대미문의 대사건 아닌가. 정부가 이들에게 ‘패가망신할 수 있다’면서 억압적인 태도를 보여서는 안 된다. 광장의 요구를 제도권에서 받아 안겠다는 책임감으로 임하겠다.”)

– People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk is calling for a full re-election. (－장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 ‘전면 재선거’를 주장하고 있다.)

“I interpret this as reflecting the immense public distrust in election management. However, it’s also true that the legal hurdles are high. The party has already filed an election petition, so we can discuss the next steps at a general meeting of lawmakers based on the results. Still, what leader Jang advocates differs from the views of lawmakers inside the assembly. He may have his own convictions, but politicians should not ride the wave of public fury. They should focus on finding solutions within the institutional framework.” (“(선거 관리에 대한) 국민적 불신이 크다는 의미로 이해하고 있다. 그러나 법리적으로 문턱이 높은 것도 사실이다. 당 차원에서 이미 선거소청을 접수했으니, 그 결과에 따라 의원총회에서 다음 단계를 논의하면 될 것이다. 다만 장 대표가 주장하는 내용은 원내 의원들과는 차이가 있다. 장 대표 나름의 신념이 있겠지만, 정치인은 광장의 분노에 올라타서는 안 된다. 제도권에서의 해결책 마련에 집중해야 한다.”)

item.title: Han Seong-sook Apologizes for Data Leak in ‘Everyone’s Startup’: "Will Establish Measures to Protect Participants’ Ideas" (한성숙 ‘모두의 창업’ 정보 유출에 사과 “도전자 아이디어 보호 대책 마련하겠다”)
item.description:
Han Seong-sook Apologizes for Data Leak in ‘Everyone’s Startup’: "Will Establish Measures to Protect Participants’ Ideas" (한성숙 ‘모두의 창업’ 정보 유출에 사과 “도전자 아이디어 보호 대책 마련하겠다”)

Han Seong-sook, Prime Minister nominee and Minister of SMEs and Startups, apologized on the 22nd for the leak of participants’ personal information and startup ideas from the Ministry’s startup platform, ‘Everyone’s Startup.’ (한성숙 국무총리 후보자 겸 중소벤처기업부 장관이 22일 중기부의 창업 플랫폼 ‘모두의 창업’에서 참가자 개인정보와 창업 아이디어가 유출된 데 대해 사과했다.)

Han issued an apology statement as she arrived at the Prime Minister nominee confirmation hearing preparation office at the Financial Supervisory Service Training Institute in Tongui-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, at 9 a.m. that day. She did not take questions. (한 후보자는 이날 오전 9시 서울 종로구 통의동의 금융감독원 연수원에 마련된 총리 후보자 인사청문회준비단 사무실로 출근하면서 사과문을 발표했다. 질문은 받지 않았다.)

Han stated, "I failed to uphold the trust of those who trusted the government and embarked on their startup journey," adding, "As the minister responsible, I feel a heavy sense of responsibility and deeply apologize." (한 후보자는 “정부를 믿고 창업에 도전해 주신 여러분의 신뢰를 지켜 드리지 못했다”며 “주무 부처 장관으로서 무거운 책임을 통감하며 깊이 송구하다는 말씀을 드린다”고 했다.)

"‘Everyone’s Startup’ is not a finished product," Han said, "but no policy objective can outweigh the responsibility of failing to protect citizens’ personal information and trust." (한 후보자는 “모두의 창업은 완성된 결과물이 아니다”라면서도 “어떠한 정책적 취지도 국민의 개인정보와 신뢰를 지키지 못한 책임보다 앞설 수는 없다”고 했다.)

She continued, "Prioritizing the protection of affected users, I will swiftly implement necessary measures to prevent further damage, while also devising plans to ensure participants’ ideas are securely protected." She added, "I will correct the issues and rebuild this into a fair and trusted program where citizens can participate with peace of mind." (이어 “피해를 입으신 이용자 보호를 최우선으로 삼아, 추가 피해가 발생하지 않도록 필요한 조치를 신속히 시행하는 한편, 도전자의 아이디어가 안전하게 보호받을 수 있도록 대책도 마련하겠다”고 했다. “문제를 바로잡고 국민께서 안심하고 참여할 수 있는 공정하고 신뢰받는 사업으로 다시 세우겠다”고도 했다.)

‘Everyone’s Startup’ is a startup competition hosted by the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, conducted in a tournament format, with the final winner receiving a 1 billion won support package including prize money and investment. It is a signature policy of Han as Minister. The program succeeded in attracting over 60,000 applicants, leading President Lee Jae-myung to publicly praise Han, saying, "Thank you for the great achievement." (모두의 창업은 중기부가 주관하는 창업 경진 대회로, 토너먼트식으로 진행되고 최종 우승자에게는 상금과 투자 등 사업 자금 10억원이 지원된다. 한 후보자의 중기부 장관으로서 한 대표 정책이다. 6만명이 넘게 지원하면서 흥행에 성공해 이재명 대통령이 “큰 성과 감사하다”며 한 후보자를 공개적으로 칭찬하기도 했다.)

However, it was revealed that the email addresses, idea summaries, and evaluation comments of 5,000 first-round successful applicants were leaked. The Ministry became aware of the leak on the 15th but only notified victims on the 18th and reported it to the Korea Internet & Security Agency (KISA). (그러나 모두의 창업에 지원해 1차 합격한 5000명의 이메일 주소, 아이디어 요약, 심사평 등이 유출된 것으로 나타났다. 중기부는 지난 15일 유출을 인지했지만, 지난 18일에야 피해자들에게 유출 사실을 알리고 한국인터넷진흥원(KISA)에 신고했다.)

◇Full text of Prime Minister nominee Han Seong-sook’s apology (◇한성숙 총리 후보자 사과문 전문)

Dear fellow citizens, I am Han Seong-sook, Minister of SMEs and Startups. First, I sincerely apologize to the users who have experienced worry and inconvenience due to the personal information leak on the ‘Everyone’s Startup’ platform. (존경하는 국민 여러분, 중소벤처기업부 장관 한성숙입니다. 먼저 모두의 창업 플랫폼 개인정보 유출로 인해 걱정과 불편을 겪으신 이용자 여러분께 진심으로 사과드립니다.)

I failed to uphold the trust of those who trusted the government and embarked on their startup journey. As the minister responsible, I feel a heavy sense of responsibility and deeply apologize. (정부를 믿고 창업에 도전해 주신 여러분의 신뢰를 지켜 드리지 못했습니다. 주무 부처 장관으로서 무거운 책임을 통감하며 깊이 송구하다는 말씀을 드립니다.)

‘Everyone’s Startup’ was launched with the emphasis that it is not a finished product but a project in the process of being built together. However, no policy objective can outweigh the responsibility of failing to protect citizens’ personal information and trust. (모두의 창업은 완성된 결과물이 아니고, 함께 만들어 가는 과정의 프로젝트라는 점에 주안점을 두고 시작했습니다. 그렇지만 어떠한 정책적 취지도 국민의 개인정보와 신뢰를 지키지 못한 책임보다 앞설 수는 없습니다.)

The Ministry of SMEs and Startups took emergency security measures, such as blocking external access, immediately upon recognizing the incident. We are currently investigating the cause of the incident, the details of the leak, and the scope of damage with relevant agencies. To ensure the objectivity and expertise of the security review, we will also conduct security diagnostics and develop improvement measures with external security experts. Above all, prioritizing the protection of affected users, I will swiftly implement necessary measures to prevent further damage, while also devising plans to ensure participants’ ideas are securely protected. (중소벤처기업부는 사고를 인지한 즉시 외부 접근을 차단하는 등 긴급 보안 조치를 시행했습니다. 현재 관계 기관과 함께 사고 원인과 유출의 경위, 피해 범위를 조사하고 있으며, 보안 점검의 객관성과 전문성을 확보하기 위해 외부 보안 전문 기관과 보안 진단과 개선 대책 마련도 함께 병행하겠습니다. 무엇보다 피해를 입으신 이용자 보호를 최우선으로 삼아, 추가 피해가 발생하지 않도록 필요한 조치를 신속히 시행하는 한편, 도전자의 아이디어가 안전하게 보호받을 수 있도록 대책도 마련하겠습니다.)

Furthermore, regarding this incident, I will thoroughly examine the various concerns raised in advance and the overall system construction and operation process, and verify whether necessary actions were taken in a timely manner and whether there were any shortcomings in management and oversight. (아울러 이번 사고와 관련해 사전에 제기된 여러 우려와 시스템 구축·운영 과정의 전반도 면밀히 살펴보고, 필요한 조치가 적시에 이뤄졌는지, 관리·감독에 부족한 점은 없었는지도 철저히 확인하겠습니다.)

Using this incident as a turning point, I will fully review the personal information protection and security management system, strengthen supervision of external contractors and security vulnerability checks, and manage thoroughly to prevent similar cases from recurring. The investigation results will be transparently disclosed to the public, and any faults and responsibilities will be handled strictly. (이번 일을 계기로 개인정보 보호와 보안 관리 체계를 전면 재검토하고, 외부 위탁 업체에 대한 감독과 보안 취약점 점검을 강화하는 등 유사 사례가 재발하지 않도록 철저히 관리해 나가겠습니다. 조사 결과는 국민 여러분께 투명하게 공개하고, 잘못과 책임에 대해서는 엄정하게 조치하겠습니다.)

Startups are a challenge to build a future with one’s own ideas and potential, and as a source of new businesses, jobs, and new growth engines for our economy, it is a very important youth policy and national task. Therefore, this incident must not dampen young people’s passion and will to start businesses. (창업은 자신의 아이디어와 가능성으로 미래를 만들어 가는 도전이자, 새로운 기업과 일자리, 우리 경제의 새로운 성장 동력이라는 점에서 매우 중요한 청년 정책이자 국가적 과제입니다. 그렇기에 이번 일로 인해 청년들의 창업을 향한 열정과 도전 의지가 꺾여서는 안 될 것입니다.)

I will reassess to ensure that those dreaming of starting a business do not hesitate to take on new challenges. I will also meet directly with future participants of ‘Everyone’s Startup.’ I will earnestly accept your criticisms and suggestions. I will correct the issues and rebuild this into a fair and trusted program where citizens can participate with peace of mind. (창업을 꿈꾸는 분들이 새로운 도전을 주저하는 일이 없도록 다시 살피겠습니다. 향후 모두의 창업 참가자 여러분도 직접 만나겠습니다. 도전자 여러분의 질책도, 제안도 무겁게 받아들이겠습니다. 문제를 바로잡고 국민께서 안심하고 참여할 수 있는 공정하고 신뢰받는 사업으로 다시 세우겠습니다.)

I once again deeply apologize to the citizens and will do my utmost to restore trust through a thorough investigation into the cause and responsible follow-up measures. (국민 여러분께 다시 한번 깊이 사과드리고, 철저한 원인 규명과 책임 있는 후속 조치들을 통해서 신뢰를 회복할 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠습니다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil's "If Jung Runs, I'll Also Run" Met with "Quite Ridiculous" from Rep. Jung's Side (송영길 ‘鄭 나가면 나도 출마’에 정 대표 측 “대단히 우습다”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil's "If Jung Runs, I'll Also Run" Met with "Quite Ridiculous" from Rep. Jung's Side (송영길 ‘鄭 나가면 나도 출마’에 정 대표 측 “대단히 우습다” )

Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil said on the 22nd, "After the 2022 presidential election defeat, despite then-candidate Lee Jae-myung's urging to stay, I resigned as party leader the very next day to take responsibility," effectively urging current party leader Jung Cheong-rae to abandon any bid for reelection. Ahead of the party's August national convention, the pro-Lee faction is backing Minister of the Interior and Safety Kim Min-seok and lawmakers like Song. In response, Rep. Jung's side pushed back, saying, "Pressuring a specific individual is not desirable." (송영길 더불어민주당 의원은 22일 “지난 2022년 대선 패배 당시 이재명 후보의 만류가 있었지만 바로 다음 날 책임을 지고 당 대표를 사임했다”며 정청래 민주당 대표를 향해 사실상 당 대표 연임 포기를 재차 촉구했다. 8월 민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 친명계는 김민석 국무총리와 함께 송 의원 등을 밀고 있다. 이에 정 대표 측은 “특정인에 대한 압박은 바람직하지 않다”고 반발했다.)

In a radio interview that day, Song said of the June 3 local election results, "Those associated with the Jung Cheong-rae leadership see it as a formal victory, but a considerable number of lawmakers point to it as a de facto defeat. There is a difference in how we perceive the situation. If the diagnosis of the situation differs, the solutions must inevitably be different." (송 의원은 이날 라디오 인터뷰에서 6.3 지방선거 결과를 두고 “정청래 지도부와 관련된 분들은 형식적으로 승리라고 보지만 상당수 의원은 사실상 패배로 지적한다”며 “상황 인식에 차이가 있다. 상황 진단이 다르면 해법도 달라질 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

Song added, "It's not about me becoming party leader; what matters is how the Democratic Party can heal this wound and unite to support a future Lee Jae-myung administration. The national convention should serve as a crucial turning point for the party's direction." Regarding his own potential candidacy, Song said, "I'm watching to see what decision Rep. Jung will make." (송 의원은 “내가 당대표가 되는 것이 중요한 게 아니라 민주당이 이번 상처를 어떻게 보듬고 통합해 이재명 정부를 뒷받침할지가 중요하다”며 “전당대회가 당의 진로를 결정하는 중요한 계기가 돼야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 송 의원 본인의 출마 여부에 대해선 “정 대표가 어떤 결정을 할지 지켜보고 있다”고 했다.)

On Minister Kim Min-seok, Song commented, "He admirably supported President Lee Jae-myung and is a person of outstanding capability," adding, "He is a figure fully qualified to be party leader." However, on the possibility of forming an alliance with Kim, Song merely stated, "The national convention should be a forum to discuss the success of a future Lee Jae-myung government and the party's future, not a mudslinging contest that digs up the past." (김 총리에 대해 송 의원은 “이재명 대통령을 잘 뒷받침했고 뛰어난 역량을 가진 분”이라며 “당 대표로서 충분한 자격이 있는 인물”이라고 했다. 다만 김 총리와의 연대 가능성에 대해선 “전당대회가 과거를 파헤치는 이전투구가 아니라 이재명 정부의 성공과 당의 미래를 논의하는 장이 돼야 한다”고만 했다.)

Rep. Jung's side expressed displeasure over Song's remark that he would run if Rep. Jung ran for party leader. (정 대표 측은 ‘정청래 대표가 당대표 선거에 출마하면 나도 출마한다’는 송 의원 발언에 대해 불쾌감을 드러냈다.)

Lawmaker Han Min-soo, chief of staff to Rep. Jung, said in a radio interview that day, "If he wants to challenge for the party leadership at the August 17 convention, that's his own decision, his own intention. Linking it to Rep. Jung's candidacy—I think many people would find that quite, very ridiculous." (정 대표 비서실장인 한민수 더불어민주당 의원은 이날 라디오 인터뷰에서 “본인이 8·17 전당대회에서 민주당 당대표에 도전하신다면 본인 뜻대로, 본인 의중대로 하는 것”이라며 “(정 대표의 출마와 연관짓는 건) 대단히, 많이 우습다는 생각을 하시는 분들이 많을 것 같다”고 했다.)

"Why is his own candidacy tied to Rep. Jung's reelection?" Han questioned. "By my common sense, he is making statements that are not readily understandable." He added, "As he is a senior party figure, wouldn't it be appropriate for him to exercise more restraint with expressions that could be misinterpreted by our party members and supporters?" (“왜 본인의 출마와 정 대표의 연임이 연결돼 있냐”며 “제 상식으로는 선뜻 이해가 안되는 말씀을 하고 계신다”라고 했다. 이어 “우리 당원들과 지지자들이 볼 때 잘못 해석될 수 있는 표현들은 당의 중진인 만큼 조금 자제하시는 게 맞지 않겠나”라고 했다.)

On calls from the pro-Lee faction for Rep. Jung to not seek reelection, Han said, "Individual lawmakers can freely express their opinions, but making it seem like pressure on a specific individual is not desirable. I hope he would carefully consider how his statements will be perceived externally when making any remarks." <<>> (친명계에서 정 대표의 연임 불출마 요구가 나오는 데 대해선 “개별 의원들이 자유롭게 본인의 의견을 말할 수 있지만, 특정인에 대한 압박으로 느껴지게 하는 것은 바람직하지 않다”며 “어떤 발언을 할 때 발언이 어떻게 외부로 비춰질지를 신중하게 고려하면서 말씀하셨으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon's First Bill Proposed...Kim Ki-hyun, Yoon Jae-ok, Seo Cheon-ho, and Kim Dae-sik Also Participate (한동훈 1호 법안 발의...김기현·윤재옥·서천호·김대식도 참여)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon's First Bill Proposed...Kim Ki-hyun, Yoon Jae-ok, Seo Cheon-ho, and Kim Dae-sik Also Participate (한동훈 1호 법안 발의...김기현·윤재옥·서천호·김대식도 참여)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon’s first proposed bill has been found to include not only pro-Han factions within the People Power Party but also senior lawmakers and those classified as members of the party leadership. (무소속 한동훈 의원이 발의한 ‘1호 법안’에 국민의힘 내 친한계 의원들뿐 아니라 중진 의원과 당권파로 분류되는 의원들까지 다수 이름을 올린 것으로 확인됐다.)

According to the National Assembly's legislative support system on the 22nd, Representative Han submitted a bill to the internal system on the 18th to propose an amendment to the Board of Audit and Inspection Act as the primary sponsor. The bill adds the duties of the National Election Commission and its affiliated public officials to the scope of the Board of Audit and Inspection's oversight. (22일 국회 입안지원시스템에 따르면 한 의원은 지난 18일 감사원법 개정안을 대표 발의하겠다고 내부 시스템에 법안을 올렸다. 법안은 감사원의 감찰 대상에 중앙선거관리위원회 사무와 소속 공무원에 대한 직무를 추가하는 내용이다.)

In the proposal’s rationale, Han cited the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections, stating, “At the root of this problem lies the structural issue that the National Election Commission has been in a blind spot for external audits.” He added, “The independence of the National Election Commission is solely to ensure the fairness of election management, not to exempt it from accountability for incompetence and corruption. Therefore, I aim to establish a clear legal basis for the Board of Audit and Inspection to conduct oversight of the National Election Commission, and to prevent any political intervention under the guise of audits by ensuring that audit results are not reported to the president, thereby maintaining neutrality and fairness in elections.” (한 의원은 제안 이유에서 지난 6·3 지방선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태를 거론하며 “이 같은 문제의 근원에는 선관위가 그동안 외부 감사의 사각지대에 놓여 있었다는 구조적 원인이 자리하고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “선관위의 독립성은 어디까지나 선거 관리의 공정성을 보장하기 위한 것이지 그 무능과 부패에 대한 책임을 면제하기 위한 것이 아니다”라며 “이에 중앙선관위에 대한 감사원의 직무 감찰이 가능하도록 명확한 법적 근거를 마련하고 선거의 중립성과 공정성 유지를 위하여 감사 결과는 대통령에게 보고하지 않도록 해서 감사를 빌미로 한 정치적 개입의 여지 또한 차단하려는 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

As of 10 a.m. on this day, Han’s first bill was co-signed by pro-Han faction members within the People Power Party, including Kim Sung-won, Kim Hyung-dong, Park Jung-ha, Bae Hyun-jin, Seo Beom-soo, Kim Geon, Ahn Sang-hoon, Yoo Yong-won, and Han Ji-ah. Lawmakers from the minority Alternative and Future group, such as Shin Sung-beom, Lee Seong-kwon, and Cho Eun-hee, also participated. (한 의원의 ‘1호 법안’에는 이날 오전 10시 기준 국민의힘 내 친한(친한동훈)계로 분류되는 김성원·김형동·박정하·배현진·서범수·김건·안상훈·유용원·한지아 의원이 이름을 올렸다. 당내 비주류인 대안과 미래 소속인 신성범·이성권·조은희 의원도 참여했다.)

Additionally, senior party lawmakers including Kim Ki-hyun, Yoon Sang-hyun, Lee Heon-seung, Kim Tae-ho, Park Dae-chul, and Han Ki-ho were listed as co-sponsors. Lawmakers Kim Dae-sik and Seo Cheon-ho also joined. Kim serves as the chief of staff for Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, while Seo Cheon-ho holds the position of deputy director of strategic planning. (이 외에 당내 중진인 김기현·윤상현·이헌승·김태호·박대출·한기호 의원도 공동 발의자로 이름을 올렸다. 또 김대식 의원과 서천호 의원도 참여했다. 김 의원은 장동혁 대표의 특보단장, 서천호 의원은 전략기획부총장을 맡고 있다.)

One lawmaker who participated in the proposal noted, “Given that the overall incompetence and inadequacy of the National Election Commission were exposed in this election, I simply agreed to the content requiring external audits,” drawing a line against broader interpretations. (발의에 참여한 한 의원은 “이번 선거에서 중앙선관위의 총체적 무능과 부실이 드러난 만큼 외부 감사를 받도록 하는 내용에 동의한 것뿐”이라며 확대 해석에는 선을 그었다.)

Having entered the party through the recent by-election, Representative Han is expanding his ties with the People Power Party. Han recently joined the party’s study group, the Future Innovation Forum, which is mainly led by former pro-Yoon factions. This forum, established by Representative Kim Ki-hyun in June 2024, includes lawmakers such as Na Kyung-won, Yoon Sang-hyun, and three-term lawmakers Kim Jeong-jae and Lee Man-hee. (지난 보궐선거에서 당내에 입성한 한 의원은 국민의힘과 접점을 넓혀가고 있다. 한 의원은 최근 옛 친윤계가 주축인 국민의힘 공부 모임 ‘미래혁신포럼’에 가입하기도 했다. 이 모임은 김기현 의원이 2024년 6월 만든 국회 연구 단체로 나경원·윤상현 의원과 3선의 김정재·이만희 의원 등이 참여하고 있다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "The Period of Prosecution Reform, Abolish Supplementary Investigative Powers... Don't Even Dream of It, Prosecution" (정청래 “검찰개혁 마침표, 보완수사권 폐지...檢 꿈조차 꾸지마라”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "The Period of Prosecution Reform, Abolish Supplementary Investigative Powers... Don't Even Dream of It, Prosecution" (정청래 “검찰개혁 마침표, 보완수사권 폐지...檢 꿈조차 꾸지마라” )

Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 22nd regarding the issue of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers, "The period of prosecution reform is the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers." President Lee Jae-myung had previously expressed the need to retain supplementary investigative powers, stating on several occasions, "My thought is that blocking even exceptional cases with no potential for abuse could lead to problems later." In this context, Leader Jung once again took a different stance from President Lee. <<> At a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Leader Jung said, "For a complete purge of the insurrection, even the dust of the insurrection must be brought to court. I said we must make it impossible for them to even dream of an insurrection." He added, "It's the same. The great principle of prosecution reform is the complete separation of investigation and indictment. We must make it clear to the prosecution, which is eagerly fixated on preserving investigative powers, 'Don't even dream of retaining investigative powers.'" <<> Leader Jung continued, "If we grant even a spoonful of supplementary investigative powers, they will use those powers to forge a sword and could turn it against the administration at any moment." He added, "Given the prosecution's behavior so far, isn't this entirely possible? That's why I believe we must eliminate even the dust of supplementary investigative powers. The complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers is the right answer." <<> Ahead of the August party convention, Leader Jung and his supporting hardline members within the Democratic Party are pushing for the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers as a key agenda item. Although President Lee has personally stepped forward multiple times to advocate for the necessity of retaining supplementary investigative powers, Leader Jung remains adamant on this issue. <<> A source from the ruling party said, "The president still maintains that a minimal supplementary measure is necessary," and added, "The issue of supplementary investigative powers appears poised to become a major topic in the struggle for party leadership." <<> On the same day, regarding the case where former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor for Peace Lee Hwa-young was found guilty in the first trial on charges of perjury before the National Assembly related to the 'salmon drinking party' allegations, Leader Jung also said, "It's unacceptable" and "It's a very regrettable and strange ruling." <<> Leader Jung said, "Rather than ruling it a guilty verdict because there's no direct evidence of whether alcohol was consumed or not, the court should have examined whether food was actually brought in, whether there were such circumstances, and reviewed the Ministry of Justice's investigation report and records of food purchases. I express deep regret to the court that issued a guilty verdict," and added, "I hope the appellate court will reach a different judgment than the first trial." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 22일 검찰의 보완 수사권 문제에 대해 “검찰 개혁의 마침표는 보완 수사권 완전 폐지”라고 했다. 이재명 대통령은 그간 수차례 “악용될 여지가 없는 예외적인 경우까지 다 봉쇄해 놓으면 나중에 문제가 생길 수 있겠다는 게 내 생각”이라며 보완 수사권 존치가 필요하다는 취지로 발언했었다. 이런 상황에서 정 대표가 또 다시 이 대통령과 다른 입장을 내놓은 것이다.)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating Hits First Dead Cross... Positive Assessment at 46.7%, Negative at 49.7% (李대통령 지지율 첫 데드크로스... 긍정평가 46.7 부정평가 49.7%)
item.description:
President Lee's Approval Rating Hits First Dead Cross... Positive Assessment at 46.7%, Negative at 49.7% (李대통령 지지율 첫 데드크로스... 긍정평가 46.7 부정평가 49.7%)

On the 22nd, the presidential office issued an official statement regarding a poll showing that, for the first time since President Lee Jae-myung took office, negative evaluations of his state affairs performance have surpassed positive ones, marking a 'dead cross,' and expressed that it would seriously accept the public's assessment. (청와대가 22일 이재명 대통령의 국정 수행 평가에서 취임 후 처음으로 부정 평가가 긍정 평가를 앞지르는 ‘데드크로스’가 나타났다는 여론조사 결과와 관련해 공식 입장을 내고, 국민의 평가를 엄중하게 수용하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

The presidential office distributed an official statement on the recent decline in approval ratings through a media notice that day. The office stated, "The recent fluctuations in approval ratings are seen as a comprehensive reflection of the public's perception of the economic situation and their evaluation of overall state management," adding, "The presidential office will accept this seriously and humbly, and will more carefully examine what the public is worried about and what they wish for." (청와대는 이날 언론 공지를 통해 최근의 국정 지지율 하락세에 대한 공식 입장을 배포했다. 청와대는 “최근 지지율 변동은 민생 경제 상황에 대한 국민의 체감과 국정 운영 전반에 대한 평가가 종합적으로 반영된 결과로 본다”며 “청와대는 이를 엄중하고 겸허하게 받아들이며 국민께서 무엇을 걱정하고 무엇을 바라고 계신지 더욱 세심하게 살피겠다”고 했다.)

According to a survey conducted by the polling agency Realmeter on behalf of the Energy Economy News from the 15th to the 19th among 2,517 eligible voters aged 18 and over nationwide, President Lee's positive approval rating for state affairs fell by 4.8 percentage points from the previous week to 46.7%. The approval rating has been on a decline for five consecutive weeks. In contrast, the negative assessment of state affairs rose by 5.5 percentage points from the previous week to 49.7%. As a result, the negative assessment surpassed the positive one by 3.0 percentage points, marking the first dead cross since taking office. (이날 여론조사 전문기관 리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난 15~19일 닷새간 전국 18세 이상 유권자 2517명을 대상으로 조사해 발표한 결과에 따르면, 이 대통령의 국정 수행 긍정 평가는 전주 대비 4.8%포인트 하락한 46.7%로 집계됐다. 지지율은 5주 연속 하락세를 보였다. 반면 국정 수행 부정 평가는 전주 대비 5.5%포인트 상승한 49.7%를 기록했다. 이에 따라 부정 평가가 긍정 평가를 3.0%포인트 차이로 앞서며 취임 후 첫 데드크로스가 발생했다.)

Realmeter analyzed that the causes of the decline in approval ratings include the spread of responsibility triggered by the 'mismanagement of the June 3 local elections' and internal conflicts within the ruling party over leadership, which negatively impacted the overall political landscape. Additionally, despite good news such as achievements from the European tour and the KOSPI breaking through the 9,000 mark, concerns over asset market polarization became prominent, leading to a loss of support, particularly among moderate voters and in the capital region. (리얼미터 측은 지지율 하락의 원인으로 ‘6·3 지방선거 관리 부실 사태’로 인해 촉발된 책임론 확산과 여당 내 당권 갈등이 정국 전반에 부정적인 영향을 준 것으로 분석했다. 또한 유럽 순방 성과와 코스피 9000선 돌파 등의 호재가 있었음에도 불구하고, 자산 시장 양극화에 대한 우려가 부각되면서 중도층과 수도권을 중심으로 지지층 이탈이 이어진 것으로 보았다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim: "After Returning to the National Assembly, Discuss 'One-point Constitutional Amendment' for Election Commission Reform" (김 총리 “국회 복귀 후 선관위 개혁 ‘원포인트 개헌’ 논의”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim: "After Returning to the National Assembly, Discuss 'One-point Constitutional Amendment' for Election Commission Reform" (김 총리 “국회 복귀 후 선관위 개혁 ‘원포인트 개헌’ 논의”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 22nd regarding the shortage of local election ballots, "We will ensure that the National Assembly engages in full-fledged discussions on a one-point constitutional amendment related to the reform of the National Election Commission." He added, "For this issue, which the majority of the public feels is problematic, I will strive for the ruling and opposition parties to reach an agreement and create an alternative that society can accept, even through a one-point constitutional amendment." Prime Minister Kim is reportedly expected to formalize his declaration to run for the leadership of the Democratic Party around the end of this month, when the appointment process for candidate Prime Minister Han Sung-sook concludes. <<> On this day, Prime Minister Kim held a meeting with the press corps at the Government Seoul Office and said, "After stepping down as prime minister and returning to the National Assembly, I plan to focus on two things." He noted, "I believe our society and political circles have relatively lacked communication with young people and university students. Therefore, regarding the issue of suffrage, I intend to support youth-led social discourse." <<> He continued, "In addressing the issue of civic suffrage, I will make efforts in a way where the youth take the lead and the government supports from behind." He added, "Taking this suffrage issue as an opportunity, I have long pursued a platform where young people can directly step up and discuss youth issues. During today's regular briefing, I will also make a special proposal to the President regarding this, and I will actively push for this issue upon returning to the National Assembly and the party." <<> Regarding the decline in President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for state affairs after the June 3 local elections, Prime Minister Kim stated, "This is a time when the party must make efforts to support the President's administration and boost the overall approval ratings of the party and government." He added, "I believe the role of working more broadly and deeply has grown larger." Prime Minister Kim said, "Looking back at the past period, various opinion polls have shown that the President led the approval ratings for state affairs with a leadership that was almost hard to surpass, and that was a key factor." He added, "Until now, the structure has been one where the President's leadership drove the approval ratings for state affairs, and those ratings in turn pulled up the party's approval ratings." <<> He continued, "After the elections, both the approval ratings for state affairs and the party's are showing a downward trend." He added, "The election results might be pulling down the overall approval ratings of the party and government, or the party's approval ratings could be heavily declining and dragging down the state affairs approval ratings." <<> Prime Minister Kim said, "Now that the elections are over, I believe the party needs two things. One is perfect unity and cooperation between the party and government." He added, "Once I return to the party, I am increasingly feeling a sense of responsibility to do my utmost to restore the party's approval ratings in that direction, leading to a recovery in state affairs approval ratings, and further strengthening the momentum of governance." <<> Regarding his one-year term, Prime Minister Kim said, "As of July 3, my official term as prime minister will reach one year." He added, "The Office for Government Policy Coordination seems to have summarized the message, but it's a bit embarrassing to say it myself—it was a year of handling assigned tasks perfectly without any controversy." <<> He continued, "I think I managed to settle the tasks I was given to a certain extent without major controversy." He added, "Looking back, whether it was party affairs, government affairs, or elections, I feel that when given a task, I handled it without major mistakes or failures, and I consider myself fortunate." (김민석 국무총리는 22일 지방선거 용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “중앙선거관리위원회 개혁과 관련된 원포인트 개헌을 국회에서 본격적으로 논의하도록 하겠다”며 “국민 대다수가 문제의식을 느끼고 계신 이 문제만큼은 여와 야가 합의해서 개헌을 원포인트 개헌을 통해서라도 사회가 인정할 수 있는 대안을 만들어낼 수 있도록 노력하겠다”고 했다. 김 총리는 한성숙 총리 후보자의 임명 절차가 끝나는 이달 말쯤 민주당 당 대표 출마 선언을 공식화할 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Expects "Practical Appointment, Role in Prosecution Reform" from Han Chan-sik as Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs (與, 한찬식 민정수석 임명에 “실용적 인사, 검찰개혁 역할 기대”)
item.description:
Democratic Party Expects "Practical Appointment, Role in Prosecution Reform" from Han Chan-sik as Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs (與, 한찬식 민정수석 임명에 “실용적 인사, 검찰개혁 역할 기대”)

On the 22nd, the Democratic Party of Korea commented on the appointment of former prosecutor-turned-lawyer Han Chan-sik as the new Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs at the presidential office, stating, "He is regarded within the prosecution as a rational and practical figure," and added, "He is recognized as the right person for prosecution reform, as he understands the culture of the prosecution organization better than anyone." (더불어민주당은 22일 청와대 신임 민정수석비서관으로 검찰 출신인 한찬식 변호사가 임명된 것에 대해 “검찰 내에서도 합리적이고 실용적인 인사로 평가받은 인물”이라며 “검찰 조직의 문화를 누구보다 잘 알고 있어 검찰개혁의 적임자로 인정받았다”고 했다.)

In a briefing under the name of Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon, the Democratic Party said, "Regarding the prosecution reform, which is drawing public attention, the role of Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik is highly anticipated." (민주당은 이날 강준현 수석대변인 명의 브리핑에서 “세간의 관심이 쏠리고 있는 검찰개혁에 대해서도 한찬식 민정수석의 역할이 기대된다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang described Han as "a figure far removed from the outdated practices and harmful remnants of Yoon Seok-youl's political prosecution, which is tainted by manipulation," and noted, "He expressed his intention to resign from his position as a senior prosecutor just before Yoon Seok-youl's inauguration as Prosecutor General in 2019, and even after resigning, he stated his convictions on the prosecution reform desired by the public." (강 수석대변인은 한 수석에 대해 “조작으로 얼룩진 윤석열 정치검찰의 구태 및 잘못된 잔재와는 거리가 먼 인물”이라며 “2019년 윤석열 당시 검찰총장의 취임을 앞둔 시점에 검사장직에서 사의를 표명했고, 사직을 하면서도 국민이 바라는 검찰개혁에 대해 소신을 밝힌 바 있다”고 했다.)

When President Lee appointed Han as the new Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs the day before, some within the ruling party's support base voiced opposition. They raised issues with Han's background as a former prosecutor who led the investigation into the so-called 'Ministry of Environment blacklist' targeting the previous Moon Jae-in government, and his status as the son-in-law of the late Choi Byung-ryeol, former leader of the Grand National Party. The Fatherland Innovation Party also expressed concern, and some individuals voiced dissent. In response, the Democratic Party stepped forward to defend Han's appointment. (이 대통령이 전날 한 변호사를 신임 민정수석으로 임명하자 여권 지지층 일각에선 반발이 터져 나왔다. 이들은 한 수석이 문재인 정부 때 정권을 겨냥한 ‘환경부 블랙리스트’ 수사를 지휘한 검사 출신이라는 점, 고(故) 최병렬 전 한나라당 대표의 사위라는 점 등을 문제 삼았다. 조국혁신당도 우려를 표했고, 일부 인사들은 반대 의사를 표명했다. 그러자 민주당에서 나서서 한 수석 임명을 방어하고 나선 것이다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, "Beyond the separation of the Public Prosecution Service and the Senior Civil Service Corruption Investigations Office, we must now effectively design their respective authorities and functions while completing a system subject to democratic checks," and added, "Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik, who has accumulated a balanced record of strict law enforcement and human rights sensitivity, is the right person to faithfully carry this out." He further said, "We will fully support the start of the second-term presidential office staff and strongly back the government's state affairs management." (강 수석대변인은 “공소청과 중수청 분리를 넘어 이제는 각각의 권한과 기능을 효과적으로 설계함과 동시에 민주적 견제를 받는 체제로 완성해야 한다”며 “법 집행의 엄정성과 인권 감수성을 균형있게 축적해 온 한찬식 민정수석은 이를 착실하게 수행할 적임자”라고 했다. 그러면서 “청와대 2기 참모진의 출발을 전폭적으로 지원하며, 정부의 국정운영을 강력하게 뒷받침하겠다”고 했다.)
